notes: The streak moved to a tappable flame on the top bar. Tap it for the whole picture: your week, your freezes, and your longest streak ever. Freezes are now earned at 3, 7, 14 and 30 days (four in all), and each one covers a missed day automatically, so a full bank buys you four days off before a streak ends. The Learn page lost its cluttered header and the lesson card gained the goal ring.
